$comment: The shape of one plugin's declaration, plugins/<stem>/<stem>.decl.json: the plugin folder's one hand-written file. tools/omx-new-plugin.mjs drafts it and explains its fields from the titles and descriptions here; tools/gen.mjs generates everything else from it; tools/plugin-recipe.mjs validates every declaration against it. The vocabularies a renderer reads (widgets, graph kinds) are defined once, in $defs.

stem.title: Stem
stem.description: The plugin's file name: omx-<short>, its directory under plugins/, its .clap and its .lv2 bundle. The short name is lower case, its words joined by hyphens (omx-keyed-gate). Unique.

kernel.title: Kernel
kernel.description: The plugin's C name, which names its generated header and its faces (omx_<kernel>_params.h, omx_<kernel>_clap.c). For a plugin over one omx-dsp kernel it is that kernel's omx-contract name.

kernels.title: Kernels
kernels.description: The omx-contract kernels the parameters reference (data/kernels/<kernel>.json). One entry is the normal case; several make a composite, and then each parameter names its kernel. A kernel omx-contract does not have yet is NEW: the kernel recipe in omx-contract and omx-dsp runs first. Defaults to [kernel].

noun.title: Noun
noun.description: How the packages' descriptions and the changelog name the effect in prose ("8-band EQ", "channel strip"). Defaults to the short name.

version.title: Version
version.description: The release the plugin ships in: the Makefile's VERSION.

description.title: Description
description.description: One plain sentence a host shows: what the effect does for you. A described plugin's is its descriptor's plugin.doc, never its extras file.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The plugin's row in the README's catalogue, when it says more than the description (ranges, latency, rates). Left out, the row reads the description.

features.title: CLAP features
features.description: The CLAP feature strings: audio-effect and stereo for every effect, plus the kind (delay, distortion, equalizer, ...). A described plugin's are its descriptor's plugin.features and extension bag (docs/declaration-as-descriptor.md), never its extras file.

class.title: LV2 class
class.description: The LV2 plugin class: lv2:DelayPlugin, lv2:ModulatorPlugin, lv2:Plugin, ... A described plugin's is in its descriptor's extension bag (rdf:type), never its extras file.

enabledPort.title: Enabled port
enabledPort.description: Where the host's bypass port `enabled` sits among the LV2 control ports: before the parameters (first) or after them (last, the default). A plugin that replaces an existing bundle keeps that bundle's port order.

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: `instance`: the plugin runs omx-dsp's instance face of its kernel (<omxdsp/fx/omx_<kernel>_instance.h>), and tools/gen.mjs generates the kernel binding, the kernel-identity test, both faces and the Makefile from this declaration; each parameter binds to the `resolve` argument named after its contract control. `chain`: a composite, its parameters generated from `chain`: each element binds to its own kernel's instance face exactly as `instance` does, and the binding runs them in order. Left out, those files are the plugin's own (a composite, a face omx-dsp does not have).

params.title: Parameters
params.description: The parameters, in order. Append-only once released: the order is the CLAP param id and the LV2 port order. A `binding: chain` declaration has none: its list is generated from `chain`.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: For `binding: chain`: the elements, in the order they run (the console's order for that strip kind). The parameter list is generated from it: element by element, each element's switch `<id>On` (default its `on`), then its parameters; then the plugin's own `order` when `order` is `permutable`. Append-only once released, as any parameter list.

order.title: Order
order.description: For `binding: chain`: `permutable` adds the plugin's own integer parameter `order` over the permutations of the elements, lexicographic, 0 the declared order. Left out, the chain runs in its declared order.

key.title: Key
key.description: For `binding: chain`: the id of the one element whose keyed face takes the plugin's `sidechain`. The other keyed elements run self-keyed.

shipped.title: Shipped
shipped.description: For a chain converted from a released plugin: the release tag whose parameter list it replaces. tools/gen.mjs reads that release's symbols with git and refuses a flattened list that differs, unless `shippedDiff` names exactly every difference.

shippedDiff.title: Shipped difference
shippedDiff.description: Every index at which the flattened list differs from the `shipped` release's, as tools/gen.mjs prints them (`<index> <was> -> <now>`, `+<index> <added>`, `-<index> <removed>`): the decision, written down.

sidechain.title: Sidechain
sidechain.description: A key input beside the stereo main pair, for an effect whose detector a host may feed from another signal: in LV2 an optional lv2:isSideChain audio input right after in_r, in CLAP a second, mono, non-main input port. Leave it out for an effect with no key.

name.title: Name
name.description: The label a host shows for the key input.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.description: A `binding: instance` plugin's controls of its kernel that are no parameter, each passed at one value, as a chain element's `fixed` says: controls a kernel release added that the plugin does not expose yet (each at its declared default, which omx-dsp holds bit-identical to the kernel without it).

portHints.title: Port hints
portHints.description: The pin of the LV2 port hints (tools/port-hints.mjs, `make hints`): by port symbol, the hints a host draws the port from that the generated TTL must keep — its port properties, its unit and its labelled scale points ("<value> <label>"). A face may gain hints; losing one is red until the pin here is changed on purpose. Written by tools/omx-new-plugin.mjs from the first generated TTL; a per-band symbol of a declaration with variants pins every band. tools/gen.mjs assembles every plugin's pin into the git-ignored view tools/test/port-hints.json.

resourceHints.title: Resource hints
resourceHints.description: What the plugin declares about its own footprint, by the word of omx-contract's RESOURCE_HINTS (omx-contract >= 3.1.0, docs/resource-hints.md): a flag hint (streams-from-disk, opens-sockets) true or false, a figure (threads-spawned, a count; the footprints, bytes; activate-time, ms) a whole number. tools/gen.mjs renders it as the CLAP face's org.openmixer.resource-hints.draft/0 and as the LV2 face's omxres: properties, and refuses a word the installed contract does not declare. A hint left out is unknown, never zero. Every shipped plugin states threads-spawned, streams-from-disk and opens-sockets (tools/test/resource-hints-check.mjs); a figure that needs a measurement waits for one.

latencyChecks.title: Latency checks
latencyChecks.description: The latency each face reports, held to what the kernel does: for each entry the identity test (test/<kernel>-oracle.c), at every declared rate, through the CLAP face and the LV2 face, sets the named parameters (the rest at their defaults), runs a unit impulse and reads the reported latency, after the restart a CLAP face asks for. `impulse`: the impulse's peak lands within one frame of the reported latency (the kernel's delay can be fractional; the report is its rounding), and a report of 0 would not. A number: the reported latency is that many frames. Left out, no latency is measured beyond the identity test's own check that the faces report the kernel's.

oracles.title: Oracles
oracles.description: Hand-written oracles beside the generated identity test, each test/<name>.c in the plugin folder: an oracle moved from the console engine with its effect, run on the built faces at the nine oracle rates (docs/new-plugin-from-contract.md). The generated Makefile builds each one and runs it in make test as `<name> clap <stem>.clap` and `<name> lv2 <bundle> <uri>`; tools/gen.mjs refuses a name whose file is missing. Left out, the identity test is the plugin's only oracle.

meters.title: Meters
meters.description: The meters the CLAP face reports through clap.meters/1 (docs/meters.md), in order: the CLAP meter id is the index, append-only once released. Every one is coherent: the face publishes all their values after each block at once (include/omx_meter_ring.h), and a read never mixes two blocks; the identity test holds every channel to a reference computed from the same block, at every declared rate. Left out, the face has no meters.

manual.title: Manual
manual.description: The plugin's section of the README below its heading, one Markdown line per entry. A number a parameter holds is never typed here: {range:<symbol>} and {default:<symbol>} read as the parameter table words them, {min:<symbol>} and {max:<symbol>} the bare limit, all from the resolved parameter. Left out, the section is the parameter table generated from the resolved parameters, and "Plus the host's bypass."

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: ONE declaration for several plugins that differ in a band count only (tools/variants.mjs): `count` names omx-contract's count sheet (EQ_BAND_COUNTS), `of` each variant, its stem and its sheet key. The variants' folders hold generated files only; the per-band parameters (`perBand`) repeat for every band of each, and `{bands}` in the prose reads the count.

face.title: Face
face.description: Written by tools/variants.mjs for a variant: the omx-dsp instance face it binds, its base's kernel, where `kernel` names the variant's own files.

variantOf.title: Variant of
variantOf.description: Written by tools/variants.mjs for a variant: its base, its count sheet, key and band count.

subgroups.title: Subgroups
subgroups.description: Written by tools/variants.mjs for a variant: by section key, the LV2 port groups a section marked `"subgroups": "band"` is split into, one per band (`band<n>`, `Band <n>`), each with that band's controls of the section in the section's order. tools/gen.mjs refuses it in a declaration without variants.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the plugin is for: `ship`, the default, a plugin the packages install and every picker lists. A test plugin says `test` and is declared by `$defs.testPlugin` instead.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: The parameter's field name: its LV2 symbol and its CLAP identity.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: The omx-contract export that holds the travel: a name in the kernel's file (or in primitives.json/rates.json): a travel, a boolean, a list or a set. The numbers are read from it, never typed here.

kernel.title: Kernel
kernel.description: For a composite (several kernels): which of the plugin's kernels the reference is read from.

field.title: Field
field.description: For a reference whose travels are per field (GATE_LIMITS and the like): which field.

forKind.title: For kind
forKind.description: For a travel whose default differs per strip kind: the kind whose default a plugin takes (input, for an insert).

defaultRef.title: Default reference
defaultRef.description: Where a fresh plugin comes up when the export names no default of its own: for a list, the scalar export naming the value; for a travel, a number inside a sheet (NAME.field, as EQ_BAND_DEFAULTS.gainDb).

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: How a host should draw the travel. Left out, a frequency (unit Hz) is logarithmic and every other travel linear.

values.title: Values
values.description: For an integer parameter that picks one of a few choices: the label of each value from min up, one per step. LV2 then lists them as an enumeration of scale points.

points.title: Points
points.description: For an integer parameter that takes only some of the values in its travel (a slope of 12 or 24 dB/oct): each value it takes with its label, from min up to max. LV2 then lists them as an enumeration of scale points. A parameter has values or points, not both.

defaultId.title: Default id
defaultId.description: For a reference to a set that names no default: the id a fresh plugin comes up at. Refused when the set names one.

defaultBand.title: Default band
defaultBand.description: For an EQ band: the default of band `index` (0-based) in an EQ of the strip type `strip` (a key of EQ_BAND_COUNTS), or in a bank of `count` bands (a count omx-contract declares, DYNEQ_BANDS), by omx-contract's one default rule for a fresh EQ. `of` is `centre` for the band's frequency travel and `type` for its band type set. A per-band parameter gives `of` alone; tools/variants.mjs fills `strip` and `index` for each band.

own.title: Own
own.description: Why this parameter is typed here and not by reference: `switch` is a switch of the plugin's face (an on/off the contract declares nowhere), `stage-order` the strip's own stage-order table. A parameter is by reference or own, never both.

perBand.title: Per band
perBand.description: In a declaration with `variants`: the parameter repeats for every band of each variant, as `b<n>_<symbol>` named `Band <n> <name>`; a `defaultBand` given only its `of` takes the variant's strip and the band's index.

portHint.title: Port hint
portHint.description: One port's pinned hints; an empty one is left out.

props.description: The port properties, sorted (lv2:integer, lv2:enumeration, lv2:toggled, pprops:logarithmic, ...).

points.description: The labelled scale points, "<value> <label>", from the lowest value up.

subgroups.title: Subgroups
subgroups.description: LV2 port groups finer than the section, in a declaration with variants: `band` makes each band's controls of the section a port group of its own, `Band <n>` (symbol `band<n>`), in band order; the section stays as drawn. A control's descriptor `group` is then the path [section label, band label]: the panel section first, the LV2 group last (FreeMixer/omx-plugins#257).

section.title: Section
section.description: One group of controls drawn together, by parameter symbol in drawing order; `graph` names the graph kind drawn over it. In a declaration with variants a per-band symbol stands for every band's, band by band.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The plugin's one panel, which every renderer draws: the MOD GUI (omx-panel writes it), the OpenMixer console and, later, a native window. A family, each control's role, each control's widget, and the sections in drawing order, each with the graph drawn over it. Every plugin declares one, and it draws every parameter; the wizard drafts one section of every parameter, its family from the kernel's.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Each role the family's panel draws, by name, to the parameter that plays it: a symbol, or for an indexed role (`$defs.indexedRole`, an EQ band's) the symbols of every band in order. A role is one of its family's (`$defs.familyRoles`); a family other than none names at least one. In a declaration with variants a per-band symbol stands for every band's.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.description: Each control's widget, by parameter symbol: one of the shared widgets every renderer has. A control left out takes its renderer's default for its kind (a toggle a switch, labelled values or an integer of a few steps a selector, any other travel a knob).

family.title: Family
family.description: The panel families the console accepts, a closed set: the family names which panel the console draws and which roles it reads. An effect no family fits is `none` (the console draws its generic editor). The list is the console's; a family is added there first, then here, with its roles in `familyRoles`.

familyRoles.title: Roles of each family
familyRoles.description: Each family's roles, the only ones the console reads for it (a role outside its family is dropped). One entry per `family`, each family's roles omx-panel's (its `ROLES`, the one table), which tools/plugin-recipe.mjs holds equal.

indexedRole.description: The roles that repeat by index, one parameter per band: the only roles that may name a list of symbols. The list is omx-panel's (schema/panel.schema.json), the one place it is written.

widget.description: The shared widgets a control is drawn with, by the names the console reads (its `auto` is a control left out of `widgets`). The list is omx-panel's (schema/panel.schema.json), the one place it is written, and every renderer reads it.

graph.title: Graph
graph.description: The graph kinds a panel section may draw, computed by the renderer from the section's controls: the console draws eq-curve (EqCurve), dynamics-curve (GateCurve, CompCurve), transfer-curve (drive's TransferCurve), delay-taps and decay-envelope (StageTimeCurve's delay taps and reverb decay) today. A new kind is added here once, and in each renderer.

values.description: The parameters the check sets, by symbol; every other parameter is at its default.

reports.description: `impulse`: the reported latency is where an impulse lands. A number: the frames the faces report.

id.description: The meter's symbol and its clap_meter_info name, from which a host derives its output symbol; unique among the meters and the parameters.

kind.description: `gain_reduction`: dB with CLAP's sign, 0 none, negative a reduction; one channel (one detector drives every leg), the kernel's reading at `field` or through `read`; 0 while bypassed. `level`: the stereo pair's peak over the block in dBFS at the plugin's `source`, two channels (left, right), measured by the face because the kernel keeps no level; floored at `min`. Or a level the kernel reads itself (a detector's): one channel through `read`, over the range of its `readout`, the range's minimum while bypassed.

field.description: Where the kernel's reading is in its instance face's state, a member path of the instance (`state.band.gr_min_db`): the face reads it after each block and computes nothing of its own.

read.description: Instead of `field`: the instance face's reading function, `omx_<kernel>_instance_<read>`, called on the instance after each block, with its band index when one is given (`band_gr_db(0)`): the kernel's readout as omx-dsp computes it, nothing computed here.

floor.description: The parameter whose travel's low end is the deepest reduction the kernel applies: the meter's display minimum (its maximum is 0 dB).

readout.description: A gain reduction's, instead of `floor`, and a level the kernel reads: the kernel's readout in omx-contract (`GAIN_REDUCTION_DB`), whose declared range is the meter's display range.

source.description: A level's: where it is measured, the plugin's inputs before the kernel runs or its outputs after.

min.description: A level's display minimum in dBFS; a quieter block, silence included, reads it.

max.description: A level's display maximum in dBFS, above `min`.

console.title: Console
console.description: How the plugin shows in the OpenMixer console, as the console draws it TODAY: where it may go, its overview card and its FX chip (its processing panel is the plugin's one `panel`). A part the console does not draw for this effect today is left out (the console then draws a racked plugin with its generic editor). The console's placement rules refuse a declaration that breaks them; the plugin cannot widen them.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Where the plugin may go in a strip's chain.

strips.title: Strip kinds
strips.description: The strip kinds that may host the plugin, in the console's names (input, fxReturn, aux, mix, matrix, main, fxSend, mixMinus).

group.title: Chain position group
group.description: Where the console's channel layout puts it: `walk`, the reorderable chain of native stages (the strip's /order row); `tail`, a fixed member after the walk (the limiter); `plugins`, the hosted plugin rack (the insert rack's strip kinds).

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: The console's native stage kind the plugin draws as today (or the limiter's fixed tail stage).

after.title: After
after.description: The stage it follows in the console's default walk (the stage file's order.after); left out for the first.

fxGroup.title: FX group
fxGroup.description: The FX group the console's menus list the plugin under (modulation, dynamics, space, ...).

order.title: Default order
order.description: Its default position among the plugins of its FX group.

card.title: Overview card
card.description: What the strip's overview card shows.

show.description: The controls the card shows, by parameter symbol (one to three; the console's gate and EQ cards show more today), or `readout:<name>` for a readout the contract declares. A per-band symbol of a declaration with variants stands for every band's.

summary.description: Text with `{symbol}` holes, each naming a declared parameter, filled with its value and unit by the console.
summary.title: Summary line

chip.description: The summary text of the strip's FX chip that opens the panel, e.g. `{timeMs} · {feedback}`; `{symbol}` names a declared parameter.
chip.title: Chip

held.title: Held
held.description: Controls of the kernel's instance face that are no parameter yet: each `resolve` argument is passed at its kernel's declared default, by the default's named macro (OMX_<ref>_DEFAULT), and is never a port. For a face argument a newer omx-dsp adds before the plugin exposes it. A control that is a field of a sheet has no macro of its own; pass it as `fixed`.

element.title: Chain element
element.description: One kernel of a chain, run through its own omx-dsp instance face.

id.title: Id
id.description: The element's name: its switch is `<id>On`, its panel section is keyed by it, its state is the binding's field of that name.

kernel.title: Kernel
kernel.description: The omx-contract kernel, whose omx-dsp instance face <omxdsp/fx/omx_<kernel>_instance.h> the element runs.

name.title: Name
name.description: The label of the element's switch and of its panel section. Defaults to the id, capitalised.

on.title: On
on.description: The default of the element's switch `<id>On`.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: The element's parameters, by reference to ITS kernel only; they bind to its face's resolve() by name, as a single plugin's do. A symbol may carry the element's id in front (`eqHpfSlope`).

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: For a kernel with per-band controls: the key of its count sheet (eq's EQ_BAND_COUNTS: strip, eq8, ...) whose `max` is how many bands the element exposes, one parameter of each per-band control per band. Left out, the element exposes no band.

faceBands.title: Face bands
faceBands.description: The count sheet key the element's face is compiled at, where it differs from `bands` (omx-dsp's eq face takes eq8, eq16 or eq32 only): the bands past `bands` are passed as `fixed` says, never exposed. Elements over one face share it. Left out, `bands`.

fixed.title: Fixed
fixed.description: Controls of the element's kernel that are no parameter, each passed at one value: a set's id, a travel's number, "default" (its declared default), or {"defaultRef": "<SHEET>.<field>"} (a default an omx-contract sheet holds). A per-band control is passed so for every band the element does not expose. For a control a chain cannot use, such as the key source of a keyed face that is not the chain's `key` (it runs self-keyed).

testPlugin.title: A test plugin
testPlugin.description: An instrument or probe a host's own tests create by CLAP id (tools/test-plugins.mjs). It is linked into libomxplugins.a and found by omx_clap_static_find(), but no picker lists it, no package installs it and the release gate never sees it. Its face, Makefile and oracles are written by hand; tools/gen.mjs writes generated/omx_<kernel>_decl.h from this declaration and lists the face in the archive's test table.

role.title: Role
role.description: `test`: hidden from every picker, never installed, created by id.

description.title: Description
description.description: One plain sentence: what the test plugin does and what a test reads from it.

constants.title: Constants
constants.description: The numbers the face runs with and its oracle predicts from, by name in camel case (`attackMs`); each becomes OMX_<KERNEL>_<NAME> in generated/omx_<kernel>_decl.h.
